newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-KASPROWICZ WINS PLACE AHEAD OF JULIAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KASPROWICZ WINS PLACE AHEAD OF JULIAN.

text.p: Queenslander Michael Kasprowicz has won a berth as the third pace bowler in the Australian side for Thursday's first test against England ahead of Brendon Julian.
Greg Blewett, who has been troubled by a knee injury, will bat at number three for the Australians, while fast bowler Jason Gillespie, who has a foot injury, has also been selected.
The team was announced after Wednesday's net practice.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Michael Kasprowicz, Glenn McGrath.
